description: 晴れた休日の朝、母親と2人の子どもがマンションの広いベランダで家庭菜園の世話をしている。中央では母親がハーブの苗を大きな植木鉢に植え替えている。高校生の娘はじょうろでトマトや花に水をやりながら葉の状態を確認している。小学生の弟は赤く熟したミニトマトを収穫し、小さなかごに入れている。周囲にはさまざまな鉢植え、園芸用具、土の袋、植物ラベル、ハーブ、花、トマトが並び、ベランダの向こうには住宅街と青空が見えている。
imagePrompt: A high-quality, detailed illustration designed for an IELTS or Eiken English speaking picture-description test. Show exactly three people on a spacious balcony of a modern Japanese apartment on a bright sunny weekend morning: one mother, one teenage daughter, and one young boy. Do not include any additional people. The atmosphere should be calm, cheerful, healthy, and cooperative. The main activity is family gardening. In the center foreground, the mother is kneeling beside a large planter and carefully transplanting a small herb plant from a temporary plastic pot into fresh soil. She is wearing simple gardening gloves and using a small hand trowel. Beside her, the teenage daughter is watering several tomato plants and colorful flowers with a green watering can. She is also examining one of the leaves closely, showing that she is checking the condition of the plants. On the other side, the young boy is happily picking ripe red cherry tomatoes from a plant and placing them into a small wicker basket. Make his harvested tomatoes clearly visible. Surround them with visually rich but organized gardening details: several pots of different sizes, tomato plants supported by stakes, basil and mint, flowering plants, a bag of potting soil, gardening gloves, a hand trowel, plant labels, a spray bottle, a small stool, a watering can, and a basket containing harvested tomatoes. Include a small outdoor table with a notebook and seed packets, but no additional people. In the background, show the balcony railing, neighboring apartment buildings, distant houses, green trees, and a clear blue sky. The three actions must be visually distinct and easy to describe: the mother transplanting herbs, the daughter watering and checking plants, and the boy harvesting tomatoes. Clear foreground, middle ground, and background. Exactly three visible people. No animals, no speech bubbles, no captions, no brand logos, no copyrighted characters. Landscape 16:9 composition, clean colorful educational illustration style, highly detailed but uncluttered, expressive natural body language, suitable for an English speaking assessment.
